changes.comment: Rework the diagnostic registry per PR review: diagnostic codes now use the distinctive RDC_ prefix enforced at compile time by template-literal type arithmetic (replacing runtime regex validation); message templates moved out of the registry into one module per diagnostic under diagnostics/codes/ with a defineRushDiagnostic authoring helper that derives resource keys; IRushRemediationAction gains an optional promptKey so a remediation can propagate as a prompt to an agent or user; createRushDiagnostic accepts the union of registered codes and falls back to definition-level default remediation. Harden the manager, protocol, and producer contracts from deep review: ReporterManager gains a closed state, idempotent close, partial-init rollback, observable flush timeouts, a never-throwing signalFlushAsync, single-shot required-failure reporting, session-qualified event ids, immutable envelopes, diagnostic privacy-floor derivation, scope-keyed coalescing, bounded per-reporter queues, and extension-name validation; ReporterMultiplexer isolates per-child failures; the NDJSON codec preserves records decoded before a bad line, enforces byte limits consistently, decodes split UTF-8 safely, and throws typed errors; helloAck carries an explicit accepted field and rejection diagnostics name the rejected features; new wire-frame type guards; producer payloads are JSON-constrained with a per-event payload map and typed scoped lifecycle emits
